SELECT MAX(FullDate) FullDate
INTO #TEMP_DATE
FROM EDS.DATE_DIM WHERE DATESK  < 20230516
AND Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'  AND YEAR IN (2023)
GROUP BY [YEAR], [Month]

/*

2023-01-31
2023-02-28
2023-03-31
2023-04-28
2023-05-15

SELECT AAS_AS_OF_DATE, COUNT(1)
FROM [EDS].[DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER]
GROUP BY AAS_AS_OF_DATE
ORDER BY AAS_AS_OF_DATE DESC

*/

DECLARE @counter int = 1
DECLARE @recordCount INT =  (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM  #TEMP_DATE)
DECLARE @ASOFDATE DATE
DECLARE @RefDate date = '2023-05-16'

WHILE @counter <= @recordCount 
BEGIN


		SELECT  @ASOFDATE = FullDate
		FROM (SELECT A.FullDate, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY A.FullDate DESC) AS RN FROM #TEMP_DATE A  ) as T
		WHERE T.RN = @counter

 SELECT AAS_ACID, OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP - ((RAND() * 20 - 10) /100) * OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, 
    YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP - ((RAND() * 20 - 10) /100) * YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
    INTO #TEMP_ACCNT_BALANCE
    FROM [EDS].[DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER]
    WHERE AAS_AS_OF_DATE = @ASOFDATE 
    GROUP BY AAS_ACID, OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP, YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP


UPDATE  U
SET U.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP = S.OUTSTANDING_BALANCE_PHP
,  U.YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP = S.YEAR_TO_DATE_AVERAGE_DAILY_BALANCE_PHP
FROM [EDS].[DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER] U INNER JOIN #TEMP_ACCNT_BALANCE S ON
    U.AAS_ACID  = S.AAS_ACID AND U.AAS_AS_OF_DATE = @ASOFDATE 


IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..#TEMP_ACCNT_BALANCE ') IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
    DROP TABLE #TEMP_ACCNT_BALANCE 
END

SET @counter = @counter + 1

END


SELECT AAS_AS_OF_DATE, count(1) FROM 
EDS.DEPOSITS_ACCOUNT_HOLDER
GROUP BY AAS_AS_OF_DATE
